title: BMCG Token Path
description: A validator for Base–Modifier–Cache Grammar token paths.

oneOf.title: Compositional Token (T)
oneOf.description: A token formed by the Cartesian product of Base and Modifier (e.g., 'PROP:01').

oneOf.title: Cache Logograph (L)
oneOf.description: A direct representation of a high-salience concept (e.g., 'L:BURIAL').
